datasheet_identity.title: BZT52C2V0S THRU BZT52C75S Surface Mount Zener Diodes

extraction_notes: The BZT52C27S electrical-characteristics row specifies VZ minimum 25.1 V, nominal 27 V, and maximum 28.9 V at IZT = 2 mA, all at Ta = 25 °C.
The same row specifies maximum ZZT = 80 ohm at IZT = 2 mA and maximum ZZK = 300 ohm at IZK = 0.5 mA; these impedance values are not representable in this schema.
The Figure 2 points are approximate digitizations of the visible curve labeled 27 at grid intersections. No intermediate points were interpolated.
The capacitance chart is a family-level typical plot with multiple bias curves and no tabulated BZT52C27S capacitance scalar at a stated bias, so capacitance is omitted.
The datasheet publishes no reverse-recovery-time specification, so reverse recovery is omitted.
The zener voltage and current use reverse-bias polarity: the cathode is positive relative to the anode.
omission_reason: No reverse-recovery specification is published. Capacitance is omitted because the datasheet provides only a family-level multi-curve plot without a tabulated BZT52C27S value at a specified bias and test frequency.
